description.zh: 指定list操作需要从此token开始。您可从ListObjectsV2结果中的NextContinuationToken获取此token。
description.en: Specifies the token from which the list operation starts. You can obtain this token from the NextContinuationToken element in the ListObjectsV2 response.

description.zh: 对Object名字进行分组的字符。所有Object名字包含指定的前缀，第一次出现Delimiter字符之间的Object作为一组元素（即CommonPrefixes）。
description.en: The character used to group objects by name. All objects whose names contain the specified prefix and that appear between the first occurrence of the delimiter character are grouped as a single element in CommonPrefixes.

description.zh:
对返回的内容进行编码并指定编码的类型。

>  Delimiter、Start-after、Prefix、NextContinuationToken以及Key使用UTF-8字符。如果Delimiter、Start-after、Prefix、NextContinuationToken以及Key中包含XML 1.0标准不支持的控制字符，您可以通过指定Encoding-type对返回结果中的Delimiter、Start-after、Prefix、NextContinuationToken以及Key进行编码。
description.en:
The encoding type of the content in the response.

> Delimiter, Start-after, Prefix, NextContinuationToken, and Key use UTF-8 encoding. If Delimiter, Start-after, Prefix, NextContinuationToken, or Key contains control characters that are not supported by XML 1.0, you can specify Encoding-type to encode Delimiter, Start-after, Prefix, NextContinuationToken, and Key in the response.

description.zh:
指定是否在返回结果中包含owner信息。可选值如下：

- true：表示返回结果中包含owner信息。

- false：表示返回结果中不包含owner信息。
description.en:
Specifies whether to include owner information in the response. Valid values:

- true: The response includes owner information.

- false: The response does not include owner information.

description.zh:
指定返回Object的最大数。
取值：大于0小于1000
默认值：100 > 如果因为Max-keys的设定无法一次完成列举，返回结果会附加一个作为下一次列举的Continuation-token。
description.en:
The maximum number of objects to return.
Valid values: greater than 0 and less than 1000.
Default value: 100. > If the number of objects exceeds the Max-keys value and not all objects can be listed in a single request, a element is included in the response as the Continuation-token for the next listing request.

description.zh:
限定返回文件的Key必须以Prefix作为前缀。
- 参数的长度必须小于1024字节。 - 使用Prefix查询时，返回的Key中仍会包含Prefix。 如果把Prefix设为某个文件夹名，则列举以此Prefix开头的文件，即该文件夹下递归的所有文件和子文件夹。
在设置Prefix的基础上，将Delimiter设置为正斜线（/）时，返回值就只列举该文件夹下的文件，文件夹下的子文件夹名返回在CommonPrefixes中，子文件夹下递归的所有文件和文件夹不显示。
例如，一个Bucket中有三个Object ，分别为fun/test.jpg、 fun/movie/001.avi和fun/movie/007.avi。若设定Prefix为fun/，则返回三个Object；如果在Prefix设置为fun/的基础上，将Delimiter设置为正斜线（/），则返回fun/test.jpg和fun/movie/。
description.en:
Specifies that only objects whose keys start with the specified prefix are returned.
- The value of this parameter must be less than 1,024 bytes in length. - If you use a prefix for a query, the returned keys still contain the prefix. If you set Prefix to the name of a folder, all objects whose names start with this prefix are listed, which includes all objects and subfolders in the folder in a recursive manner.
If you also set Delimiter to a forward slash (/) in addition to Prefix, only the objects in the folder are listed. The subfolders in the folder are returned as CommonPrefixes elements. All objects and folders in the subfolders are not displayed.
For example, a bucket contains three objects: fun/test.jpg, fun/movie/001.avi, and fun/movie/007.avi. If you set Prefix to fun/, all three objects are returned. If you set Prefix to fun/ and Delimiter to a forward slash (/), fun/test.jpg and fun/movie/ are returned.

description.zh:
设定从Start-after之后按字母排序开始返回Object。
Start-after用来实现分页显示效果，参数的长度必须小于1024字节。
做条件查询时，即使Start-after在列表中不存在，也会从符合Start-after字母排序的下一个开始打印。
description.en:
Specifies that objects are returned in alphabetical order starting after the value of Start-after.
Start-after is used to implement pagination. The value of this parameter must be less than 1,024 bytes in length.
When you perform a conditional query, objects are listed starting from the next object in alphabetical order after Start-after, even if Start-after does not exist in the list.

title.zh: 列举存储空间中所有文件的信息V2
title.en: List information about all objects in a bucket V2

descriptions.zh: 执行GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2)请求时不会返回Object中自定义的元信息。
descriptions.en: Custom object metadata is not returned when you call the GetBucketV2 (ListObjectsV2) operation.
